content:
# Investigator evidence and case writing guide

SYNTHETIC TRAINING MATERIAL. Fictional data for Project SENTINEL exercises. Not an official circular, legal guidance, human-reviewed evidence or production model output.

Write the authorisation facts first, unknowns second, and later findings in a separate dated section. Preserve the source transaction and document identifier. A decline is not a fraud label. A dispute is not necessarily an unauthorised payment. The synthetic verdict is known sixty days after the transaction. Human review is required to turn generated candidates into gold investigation examples.

title: PII handling and synthetic identifier guide
content:
# PII handling and synthetic identifier guide

SYNTHETIC TRAINING MATERIAL. Fictional data for Project SENTINEL exercises. Not an official circular, legal guidance, human-reviewed evidence or production model output.

The generator creates no names, addresses, phones, card numbers or payment handles. C, M and D identifiers are reproducible random-looking tokens, not hashes of real people. Monetary values and cities are fictional event attributes. Review a deterministic sample of one thousand documents using identifier detectors, and separately test any real corpus with an approved recogniser and a human audit. A regex pass is not a proof that arbitrary text is PII-free.

title: Training splits and label availability guide
content:
# Training splits and label availability guide

SYNTHETIC TRAINING MATERIAL. Fictional data for Project SENTINEL exercises. Not an official circular, legal guidance, human-reviewed evidence or production model output.

Authorisations from January through October 2025 form the retrospective training split. November and December 2025 form validation. January and February 2026 are holdout. All labels are mature at the May 2026 snapshot. Retrospective splitting does not recreate a model deployed on November first: use eligible_at_next_split_start for that stricter backtest. CPT candidates also require a publication date before November first. MCC encoding uses earlier training labels already mature at the frozen month boundary.

title: Supabase synthetic environment guide
content:
# Supabase synthetic environment guide

SYNTHETIC TRAINING MATERIAL. Fictional data for Project SENTINEL exercises. Not an official circular, legal guidance, human-reviewed evidence or production model output.

Load into a dedicated PostgreSQL schema using COPY over an encrypted direct or session-pooler connection. Dataset tables have RLS enabled and no anonymous or authenticated policy. Use private Storage buckets and service-side credentials. Keep a separate evaluation bucket for holdout artifacts. A private Supabase bucket does not implement the AWS Object Lock requirement in the production design. The hosted dataset is a teaching environment; the production architecture remains a separate client decision.
